meta.name: naming
meta.description: How to think about names in the Grida repo — not conventions, but what a name commits you to, reveals about the system, and costs to change. The central discipline is that a strict, honest name refuses to grow, and that refusal drives the repo's shape (flat modules, small agnostic packages, suffix siblings). Use when planning a new package, crate, module, directory, route group, or test corpus — the name comes first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为代码模块、包或目录起名时做出有远见的设计决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在为代码库规划新模块或包的结构，需要先想好名字。
copy.tagline_en: Make far-sighted naming decisions for code modules, packages, or directories
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are planning a new module or package structure and need to think through the name first.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会先帮你确定模块、包或目录的名称，再写代码。它会检查名称是否严格、诚实，能否拒绝不相关的内容，并建议用扁平结构（同级文件）或提取为新模块，避免嵌套。
howto.when: 当你计划新建一个包、模块、目录、路由组或测试集，且需要先确定名称时触发。

say.text: 我想新建一个处理画布图形的包，叫什么好？
say.note: Claude 会引导你先定名，再设计内容。

say.text: 这个模块现在既做布局又做颜色，该怎么改名？
say.note: Claude 会建议提取或重命名以保持单一职责。

say.text: 我想在 canvas 目录下加一个文本子模块，怎么命名？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you pick a name for a module, package, or directory before writing code. It checks if the name is strict and honest, refuses wrong content, and suggests flattening with siblings or extracting a new module instead of nesting.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you plan to create a new package, module, directory, route group, or test corpus and need to decide the name first.

say_en.text: I want to create a package for canvas graphics. What should I name it?
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to name first, then design.

say_en.text: This module does both layout and color. How should I rename it?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest extracting or renaming to keep one thing.

say_en.text: I want to add a text submodule under canvas. How to name it?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest flat sibling files like canvas-text/ instead of nesting.
